messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary health check failures detected on rollout 'wave-17' (region-us-west) — 12m ago. 15% 5xx from new pods, sigterm latency increased. Alerting eng-oncall and pager.

devon: seeing the same. Prod metrics are spiking around the canary nodes (cpu okay, but 5xx up). Any recent config changes besides the model swap?

maria: model version v2.13 rolled to 10% earlier in the hour, autoscaler scaled up 3 nodes. Healthcheck failures started ~8m after rollout.

sam.k: paging in. grabbing logs from the canary pods now.

alex: FYI customer-facing routes are currently split 90/10. If this keeps rising we should flip the routing or kill the flag.

sam.k: logs show repeated upstream 502s from inference runtime, stack trace points to kv-cache miss path and OOMs inside quantized kernel on a subset of GPUs.

ops-guru: can you paste the pod logs? quick grep would help.

sam.k: paste ->

```
2026-03-15T14:22:01Z ERROR inference/runtime: evict failure: OOM while allocating 512MB cache
2026-03-15T14:22:02Z WARN http: request returning 502 to client
2026-03-15T14:22:03Z INFO healthcheck: failing probe (500): backend timed out
```

maria: looks like v2.13 uses new quant kernels that reduce memory headroom. Maybe want to revert quant profile.

devon: traffic -> canary pods are at 12% errors overall, control pods stable. abort criteria threshold is 10% 5xx over 5m for canary. We're over.

sre-bot: Abort criteria met: canary-5xx-rate >= 10% over 5m. Suggested actions: pause rollout, toggle feature flag, roll back canary, open incident channel.

devon: I'm toggling the rollout flag (rollouts.wave-17.enabled = false) to stop further traffic to v2.13.

sam.k: confirmed, I hit the flag toggle. Requests are being routed back to v2.12, traffic shift in progress (~2m to propagate).

ops-guru: good. initiating a rollback of running canary pods to previous image for safety. kube rollout undo applied to canary deployment.

alex: notifying PMs and support. Sending brief customer note: "We detected an issue during a small rollout and are reverting; some requests may have had errors briefly. Full update in 1h."

maria: monitoring metrics — 5xx rate on canary traffic dropping now, cluster memory usage normalizing.

sam.k: one canary node still showing OOMs but it's draining. kubectl cordon + drain issued.

devon: did we page anyone external? any paying customer impacted more than few seconds?

alex: support reports a handful of elevated errors for latency-sensitive customers, none are on dedicated infra. Raising severity to P1 for visibility, but no data loss.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-17. Pager duty escalations sent to oncall@redwood

ops-guru: once rollback completes we should enable a safety killflag at the feature-flag level to block v2.13 from re-rolling until we validate quant profile fix.

maria: creating ticket for quant kernel rollback + repro with small prompt sets. tagging research and infra.

sam.k: collecting heapdumps from affected canary node and uploading to /tmp/incidents/wave-17/heapdumps.tar.gz

devon: handshake for handoff — I'm on lunch in 20. @maria please own post-rollback checks and the incident triage. @sam.k stay on logs.

maria: acknowledged. I'll run the full healthcheck suite, run smoke generation against canary endpoints, and confirm rollout lock.

alex: I'll draft the external outage blurb and share with support for approval. Keep updates short.

sre-bot: NOTE: rollback completed at 3501234589. Canary traffic at 0% for v2.13. Monitoring for residual 5xx.

maria: all green at 3501234599 — 5xx returned to baseline. Closing immediate mitigation phase. Next: root cause + remediation plan.

sam.k: collecting artifacts and will attach to INC-20260315-17. Early hypothesis: quant profile + memory regression in v2.13 kernels causing intermittent OOMs under production sequence distributions.

devon: thanks team. we'll run a dry-run with memory-guard and a smaller quant profile in staging before any re-roll. Postmortem + action items due EOD tomorrow.

alex: :thumbsup: sending the customer note now. I'll update this thread if support escalates.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-17 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned: maria, sam.k, devon. ETA postmortem: 2026-03-16 18:00 UTC.

maria: handoff done. I'll update runbook and link artifacts in the ticket.
